description:
NORDVIK makes drinkware for people who move.

## What this is
A collapsible coffee cup for people who want a full 350 ml cup without carrying a rigid tumbler. It also sits quietly on an office desk without taking up drawer space.

## How to use
1. Pull the body open until the rim clicks.
2. Seat the lid and press the seal ring down.
3. Fill to the 350 ml line.
4. Collapse from the base after the cup has cooled.

## What it is not for
Not for carbonated drinks, not for microwave use, and not for drinks above 60 C. The seal is built for upright carrying, not for a bag turned upside down.

## Care
The body and the lid are dishwasher safe on the top rack. Use a soft brush on the seal ring. Store it open so the silicone can air out.
